name: whl-air-cockpit-display
description: Automated browser tests for cockpit display WebRTC pages

scripts.test:e2e:remote-driving:loop: for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do echo "[loop] run $i"; E2E_PAGE=/rtc_remote_driving_validation_test.html node tests/run_local_integration_e2e.mjs || exit 1; done
scripts.test:e2e:remote-driving:degraded:loop: for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do echo "[degraded-loop] run $i"; E2E_PAGE=/rtc_remote_driving_validation_test.html E2E_QUERY=network=degraded node tests/run_local_integration_e2e.mjs || exit 1; done
scripts.test:e2e:takeover-safety:loop: for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do echo "[takeover-loop] run $i"; E2E_PAGE=/rtc_takeover_safety_validation_test.html node tests/run_local_integration_e2e.mjs || exit 1; done
